comparison.objective: Hover a no-touch thermometer over a forehead mark, then return it to its pad; candidate breaks HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Pickup, non-contact positioning and replacement versus contact insertion, bimanual impact regulation and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Thermometer is held over the mark and returned upright to the pad; candidate requires four physical fractures and contained fragments without damage.
comparison.reason: The record expressly emphasizes non-contact hovering, while the candidate depends on controlled contact impulse and fracture.
